claim: 1.1 Learning outcomes After completing this evaluation, students will be able to: Design a multi-agent workflow with clearly defined roles, hand-offs and a critic/feedback loop.
Ground LLM generation in verified source documents using retrieval (RAG) to avoid hallucinated claims
Orchestrate text, image, video, speech and audio generation tools under time and budget constraints.
Instrument an agent system with structured logs, cost tracking and one-command reproducibility.
Apply responsible-AI practices: factual grounding, consent, disclosure, safe messaging and licensing.
Maximum ₹500 (≈ USD 6) per Live Run across all paid APIs.
3 hours hard stop from brief draw to submission.
Public URL (GitHub Pages / Hugging Face Spaces / Streamlit Cloud) + source in repo Responsiveness
Logs and cost reports make every output auditable, answering "how was this AI content made?" Students graduate with a real-client portfolio piece and a reproducible agentic system on GitHub.
Any hosted API (Claude, GPT, Gemini) or local open models via Ollama / vLLM (Llama, Qwen, Mistral) RAG
LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen / AG2, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, or custom Python orchestrator LLMs
, 40 s Tone: energetic, curious Must include: one real lab activity from the fact sheet Must avoid: invented project names or results CTA: "Explore the AI electives"
